label: R18-FP-ACC-KILL-CUT
title: Remove core kill controls from non-architectural FP accumulators
scope: Eliminate core kill/reset-mux feedback into the non-architectural acc/acc_flags D enables where safe. Reset must retain deterministic zero; kill may retain dead internal payload only if state/request ownership is cleared and every later request acceptance reinitializes accumulators before any slot observes them. Add direct wrapper assertions/tests for kill during TX_RUN/TX_SLOT/TX_DONE followed by clean reissue. Preserve rsp/architectural state and all kill semantics.
validation: direct wrapper kill/reissue at TX_RUN, TX_SLOT and TX_DONE
new request acceptance proves accumulator zero before first slot
held response and reset still deterministic
acceptance: Core control inputs no longer drive acc/acc_flags solely to clear dead payload on kill; reset and the next accepted request provide the required initialization; no killed transaction can leak into a later response. Physical zero-path or improvement is claimed only from the next STA.
resource: Owner may edit and run only lightweight/static checks initially. Heavy Verilator/QEMU is serialized by the integrator; CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1.
board_policy: No Quartus assembler, bitstream, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
